text:
frank: quick flag 10 new int8-x canary shows a targeted drop on the multi-turn codegen promptset after the fuzzymerge_v4 run last night. can we triage?

naiya: numbers?

frank: micro-golden slice (n=150): exact_match down 2.3%, token_exec_success down 1.1%. looks concentrated on anchors with trailing assistant clarifications.

sam (label-ops): pulling audit - fuzzymerge_v4 collapsed ~98 entries in codegen bank. 22 of those were marked previously as gold variants by labelers.

maria: are those full deletions or merges?

sam (label-ops): merges into canonical rows, losing the original trailing lines. pre-merge ids: cg-gld-2201, cg-gld-2202, cg-gld-2217.

frank: that trailing context is often the disambiguator for multi-step completions. losing it would explain the exec failures.

naiya: let's reproduce: run qbench on int8-x with a fork that restores those merged rows intact (pin `codegen-gold-restore-98`). also include metrics: exact_match, exec_success, bleu_code.

ci-bot: queued qbench job qbench-3832101111-int8x-restore. est 10m. link: https://ci.internal/runs/3832101111

maria: infra note: int8-x also changed kv-prefix truncation ordering; that could interact with the missing trailing tokens. need to isolate dedupe impact first.

ci-bot: run complete. results: with restore pinned -> exact_match delta -0.2% vs baseline. with merge -> -2.3%.

frank: strong signal that merge caused most of the regression.

sam (label-ops): proposal: add `preserve_context` boolean to gold anchors. dedupe pipeline will skip merges when `preserve_context==true`. backfill heuristic: if sample has multi_turn==true AND trailing_line_start=="Assistant:" mark preserve_context=true. will PR.

maria: also add a micro-challenge set of 200 context-sensitive anchors to onboarding qbench so future quant experiments exercise this dimension. name: codegen-context-challenge-200.

naiya: onboarding gate: require any quantized model bring-up to pass micro-golden context diff with exact_match_delta >= -1.0% otherwise fail canary. I'll add to the rollout checklist.

sam (label-ops): opened PR: https://git.internal/p/dedupe/pull/204 (skip merges when preserve_context==true). includes unit test and an e2e smoke that runs the micro-golden diff.

frank: good. hold the int8-x canary until PR merges and the gate is active. maria please snapshot dedupe commit and goldset shards for audit.

maria: snapshot created: repo@commit:9c8b3a1; goldset_s3: s3://goldsets/snapshots/3832101111-9c8b3a1.tar.gz :lock:

frank: thanks team. once PR lands we'll re-run the onboarding qbench and resume canary.

sam (label-ops): I'll also enqueue a 2-reviewer manual check for the top-50 fuzzy merges in codegen; ETA 48h.

naiya: awesome. small but important change to avoid subtle regressions in multi-turn features. :white_check_mark:
